thread:
ashley: us-east1 GPU pool saturated, task queue spiked to ~6k. autoscaler isn't actually provisioning new nodes.

oncall-robot: :rotating_light: ALERT gpu-pool-us-east1 util=99% queue=6120 links: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1802456789

ben: seeing 504s on inference-api in us-east1, p95 > 4.5s, p99 > 9s. canary requests are failing too.

carla: autoscaler logs show repeated cloud API timeouts and quota errors. snippet:
```
E0423 10:12:33 autoscaler.go:120] CreateNodeGroup failed: 504 Gateway Timeout
error: quotaExceeded: requested 24 GPUs, available 0
E0423 10:13:01 autoscaler.go:134] retrying scale-up (attempt 3)
```

ashley: pattern is scale-up requests hit timeouts or quota responses, requests pile up and then coldstart cascades once any nodes come up.

mike: can we fail traffic to another region? eu-west1 has free GPU capacity but slightly worse p99. @ben can you start shifting?

ben: starting manual nodepool resize as a short-term hedge: gcloud container node-pools resize gpu-pool --num-nodes=50 --region=us-east1

deploy-bot: nodepool resize submitted (operation op-0a1b2c). nodes_requested=10 -> 50. watching cloud operation.

carla: autoscaler still failing with "network endpoint provisioning timeout" for many instances. looks like control-plane NAT egress in us-east1 is flaky so new VMs can't reach startup scripts/kube API.

ashley: if VMs can't reach K8s control plane, kubelet won't join. That explains nodes stuck in PROVISIONING forever. need to shift traffic and avoid further scale-ups in-region.

ben: kicking off traffic shift now: updating route weights -> us-east1 10% -> eu-west1 90% over 5m. command: /infra/traffic-shift --from us-east1 --to eu-west1 --window 300

mike: note for cost board: eu-west1 nodes are ~1.4x cost per GPU. logging cost impact for this incident.

oncall-robot: Incident updated: status=partial_failover, impacted=production inference, runbook=/runbooks/region-failover, pagerduty=page-rotation

ashley: action items: (1) validate NAT and cloud control-plane health, (2) add autoscaler backoff/retry tweaks to avoid queue-storms, (3) implement automatic near-term fallback to dedicated capacity (so we don't cross-region on first resort). I'll start a postmortem draft.

ben: manual resize got some nodes up but only after ~12m; still see join-failures. keeping eu-west1 ramp until us-east1 fully healthy. :thumbsup:

carla: collecting logs and saving autoscaler traces for postmortem. will attach kubelet and cloud-init failures to the incident.

ashley: thanks all — keep pings in this thread. if anyone sees a sudden drop in eu-west1 avail, pause shifting and call it out immediately.
